Create an enrollment QR in the server console. On a factory-reset device, open Android enterprise setup, join the LAN and scan. Opening this app alone cannot grant Device Owner.
Apps are assigned from the server. Desired and last-synced observed versions are distinct. Signed agent self-updates use the same flow.
No desired applications in the last authenticated snapshot.
Required apps, runtime permissions, camera/screen capture, user restrictions, timeout and kiosk are managed from the server. Each rule has its own observation.
Download and installer checkpoints survive process restarts. Waiting for Android or user action is not an installed-state success.

App inventory is from the last authenticated sync. Policy and operation progress comes from protected local state. Check server compliance for acknowledged results. Physical Android behavior requires device verification.
